newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks firm in London on currency moves.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks firm in London on currency moves.

text.p: Japanese stock were steady to firmer in London, led by blue chip exporters, like Sony Corp, Toyota Motor Corp and Honda Motor Co Ltd, dealers said.
Big exporting companies advanced as the dollar rallied against the Japanese yen, dealers aid.
"People are looking at the currency," said one. "The dollar getting to 122.0 (yen) helped some of the big names."
A weaker yen helps Japanese exporters because it makes their products more competitive on world markets.
In London, the Nikkei International Stock Exchange Top 50 share index was up 20.33 points to 1,437.66.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 share index closed 135.65 points higher at 18,564.78.
